name: Kogawa Minao
source: A high school girl the protagonist is a teacher over. She lacks confidence and is afraid Souhei won't be interested in a schoolgirl especially because she knows that Haruka is his girlfriend. This leads her to beg for his affection even if it means becoming his slave. She will do anything to please her master.
